Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation - exploring a short mid-cycle uplift

Hi Jordan,

After the product team sync this morning we have a short-term spike coming through Q3 — we estimate about a 2.5x increase in inference volume for a 10-week window starting mid-July. We'd like to explore a mid-contract uplift (non-annualized) that: 1) gives us burst capacity with predictable pricing; 2) co-terms with our existing 2028 renewal if possible; and 3) includes an SLA exception for the burst window to guarantee latency targets for two critical endpoints.

Can you share options and a rough cost delta? Procurement will need a formal quote/contract amendment to process a PO.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Head of AI Ops, NovaMed
elena.park@novamed.com

Cc: Chris Wong <cwong@novamed.com>

Hi Elena — thanks for the context, this is doable. High-level options below (I attached a draft SOW and a pricing worksheet for the delta):

Option A — Surge Add-on (recommended)
- 10-week burst pool: 4 x GPU-equivalent reserved during window
- Unit pricing: monthly uplift priced pro rata (we'll invoice as a single uplift charge covering the 10-week period)
- SLA: temporary priority lane with 99.5% p50/p90 latency target on two endpoints; we can add an SLA addendum for the window
- Discount: we can offer a one-time uplift discount of 18% off list for multi-week commitments if co-termed with the 2028 renewal

Option B — Temporary Reserved Slice
- Reserved capacity for the 10 weeks billed as a short-term commitment; no co-term; 12% discount off list

Operational asks from our side: a signed amendment + PO by July 12 to guarantee capacity. Legal: we can draft an amendment that pins the uplift to the 10-week window and adds the SLA exception.

I'll loop in Marissa on the commercial + Ben on finance for a quick internal approval path; if procurement needs a specific PO wording, send it over and we'll mirror that in our quote.

Jordan Blake
